review_candidates.title: Estimator
review_candidates.description: Company Description Signmedia Advertisement LLC is an advertising and signage company based in Dubai, serving a wide range of commercial clients across industries. The company focuses on delivering customized signage and visual communication solutions that help businesses strengthen their brand presence. Team members collaborate closely with clients, designers, and production staff to ensure projects are delivered on time and to specification. Working at Signmedia Advertisement LLC offers exposure to diverse projects in a fast-paced, quality-driven environment. Role Description The Estimator role is a full-time, on-site position based in Dubai. The Estimator is responsible for reviewing project inquiries and specifications, analyzing materials, labor, and production requirements, and preparing accurate cost estimates and quotations for signage and advertising projects. Day-to-day tasks include interpreting drawings and client briefs, coordinating with the sales and design teams, obtaining supplier quotes, and updating pricing databases. The Estimator also monitors ongoing projects to ensure costs align with estimates, flags variances, and supports negotiations with clients when pricing or scope changes occur. The role requires maintaining clear documentation, meeting strict deadlines, and contributing to continuous improvement of estimating processes and cost efficiency. Qualifications Strong numerical, analytical, and cost estimation skills, with the ability to interpret technical drawings and project specifications. Experience in signage, advertising, construction, or a related field, preferably in an estimating, pricing, or project coordination role. Proficiency with MS Excel and other office productivity tools; familiarity with ERP or estimating software is an advantage. Effective communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work closely with sales, design, production, and suppliers. Attention to detail, strong organizational abilities, and comfort working under time constraints and managing multiple quotations simultaneously. Ability to work on-site in Dubai and adapt to a fast-paced, client-focused environment. Relevant diploma or bachelor’s degree in engineering, business, quantity surveying, or a related discipline is preferred. Previous experience in the UAE market and knowledge of local material and labor costs are beneficial.

Your work will focus on complex challenges in resiliency, asynchronous workflows, automation, and system scalability. We value engineers with deep technical fundamentals who are eager to adapt to evolving architectures, new languages, and emerging cloud-native technologies. What's Cool About This Job Design, build, test, and operate scalable backend services and platform capabilities. Develop APIs and service integrations used across distributed and cloud-based systems. Make technical design decisions around data flow, asynchronous workflows, scalability, resiliency, and performance. Design and operate services across different cloud and platform environments, understanding how application, infrastructure, networking, and runtime decisions affect production systems. Work across modern and established platform technologies, making pragmatic decisions based on system requirements. Distributed Systems: Deep understanding of event-driven architecture, asynchronous processing, scalability, fault tolerance, and eventual consistency. DevOps & Security: Committed to Infrastructure as Code (Terraform), observability (monitoring/tracing), and integrating security (IAM, OAuth) throughout the development process.
